items.title: Galaxy Digital (NasdaqGS:GLXY) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower As Analysts Weigh AI Buildout Risks
items.summary: Galaxy Digital’s fair value estimate has shifted from US$37.94 to US$35.66 per share, signaling a modest reset in how analysts are framing the stock’s upside. Behind that change is a mix of enthusiasm for the company’s data center buildout and power pipeline, set against caution around funding conditions, political risk and the pace of AI related spending. items.title: Citigroup (C) Stock Could Be 41% Undervalued On Equity Returns
items.summary: Citigroup has delivered a very strong 3 year share price run, which puts fresh attention on whether the current valuation is supported by the returns the bank earns on its capital. With the stock now near US$119, the key issue is how that market value lines up with what the underlying business is generating on the equity and assets it puts to work. items.title: Emerging market central banks turn hawkish as inflation pressures mount, Citi says
items.summary: Investing.com - Emerging market central banks are pivoting toward a more hawkish stance to combat rising core inflation and sustained high energy costs, setting the stage for diverging local bond market returns next year, according to a research report from Citi.
